blocks.en: Ratting is the hunting and killing of NPC pirates, which can appear in asteroid belts, cosmic anomalies, cosmic signatures, and also near to gates in nullsec space. Players receive bounty payments for killing rats. A rat's bounty is tied to its ship class, and closely tracks with its expected difficulty.
blocks.zh: 刷怪（Ratting）就是猎杀 NPC 海盗。它们会出现在小行星带、宇宙异常、宇宙信号中，在00 区还会出现在星门附近。玩家击杀海盗 NPC 可以获得赏金。怪的赏金与其舰船级别挂钩，并且和它的预期难度密切相关。

blocks.en: Since combat sites can be found by probing, ratting shares a small overlap with exploration, and ratters can benefit greatly by having a ship capable of scanning down signatures.
blocks.zh: 由于战斗站点可以通过探针扫描找到，刷怪和探索有少许重叠，刷怪玩家如果有一艘能扫描信号的船会方便很多。

blocks.en: Belt ratting
blocks.zh: 刷矿带

blocks.en: Belt ratting is the act of going from asteroid belt to asteroid belt, killing the pirate NPC ships that are found there, and then going on to the next asteroid belt and doing the same there. This is done to collect the bounty and loot, as well as to get rare faction or capital NPC spawns.
blocks.zh: 刷矿带就是在一个个小行星带之间来回，击杀那里出现的海盗 NPC 舰船，然后去下一个小行星带重复同样的操作。这样做是为了获得赏金和拾取物，以及碰到稀有的势力怪或旗舰怪。

blocks.en: Picking a system
blocks.zh: 选择星系

blocks.en: There are several factors to bear in mind when selecting a system for belt ratting.
blocks.zh: 选择刷矿带的星系时，需要考虑几个因素。

blocks.en: Security Level
blocks.zh: 安全等级

blocks.en: Ratting in asteroid belts is greatly affected by the "true-sec" of the system. Both the size of the bounties and the chance of rare spawns are affected by this, with lower true-sec giving better bounties and higher chance of rare spawns. One factor in choosing a system to rat in is therefore the system's true-sec.
blocks.zh: 刷矿带受星系“真实安全等级”的影响很大。赏金高低和稀有怪的刷新几率都受它影响：真实安全等级越低，赏金越高，稀有怪出现几率也越高。因此，星系的真实安全等级是选择刷怪星系的一个因素。

blocks.en: A complicating factor, however, is the game's dynamic bounty mechanic (see below).
blocks.zh: 不过，游戏的动态赏金机制（见下文）会让情况变得复杂。

blocks.en: Number of asteroid belts
blocks.zh: 小行星带数量

blocks.en: Rats in asteroid belts respawn after about 20 minutes, so you also want a system with enough belts.
blocks.zh: 小行星带中的怪大约 20 分钟后重新刷新，所以你还需要一个矿带足够多的星系。

blocks.en: Belt ratting strategies
blocks.zh: 刷矿带策略

blocks.en: Short guide to chaining belts.
blocks.zh: 连锁刷矿带简明指南。

blocks.en: There are two main strategies for belt-ratting, clearing and chaining. Each has its own positives and drawbacks.
blocks.zh: 刷矿带主要有两种策略：清场和连锁。各有优缺点。

blocks.en: Clearing
blocks.zh: 清场

blocks.en: Clearing is just what it sounds like: kill (or clear) all rats in a belt, and move on. Clearing is best if you can only play for a short amount of time, but may disrupt other players in the area who may be chaining belts.
blocks.zh: 清场顾名思义：把一个矿带里的怪全部杀掉（即清空），然后去下一个。如果你只能玩一小会儿，清场最合适，但可能会干扰附近正在连锁刷矿带的其他玩家。

blocks.en: Chaining
blocks.zh: 连锁

blocks.en: Chaining refers to killing battleships but not the other rats in the same spawn, prompting more battleships to appear. Chaining the belts gives more ISK over time, though it might not generate as much ISK in a short ratting session.
blocks.zh: 连锁是指只击杀同一波怪中的战列舰而不打其他怪，促使刷出更多战列舰。连锁刷矿带长期来看收益更高，但在短时间的刷怪中可能赚得没那么多。

blocks.en: When you partly destroy a group of NPC rats and then leave the belt, the whole group will respawn. This means that you can keep killing battleships over and over for their high bounty. Kill only the rat battleships and leave the smaller ships. If there is a spawn without battleships, kill all of the rats to "re-roll" that particular spawn to hope for a new spawn including battleships. The aim of chaining is to have all spawns in the asteroid belts contain the battleship rat groups and thus significantly increasing both bounty and loot.
blocks.zh: 当你只打掉一组 NPC 海盗中的一部分然后离开矿带时，整组怪会重新刷新。这意味着你可以反复击杀战列舰来拿高额赏金。只杀海盗战列舰，留下小船。如果某一波怪里没有战列舰，就把它们全部杀掉来“重刷”这一波，希望新刷出的怪里有战列舰。连锁的目的是让小行星带里刷出的每一波怪都包含战列舰组，从而大幅提高赏金和拾取物收益。

blocks.en: Security status grinding
blocks.zh: 刷安全等级

blocks.en: Main article: Repairing security status
blocks.zh: 主条目：修复安全等级

blocks.en: A subset of chaining is grinding for security status. Here your goal is to kill the highest value (by bounty) in the system, and then move to another system and repeat. After 5 minutes, you can return to the original system and start the process over.
blocks.zh: 刷安全等级是连锁的一种。目标是击杀星系里（按赏金计）价值最高的怪，然后去另一个星系重复。5 分钟后，就可以回到原来的星系重新开始。

blocks.en: Rare spawns
blocks.zh: 稀有刷新

blocks.en: Hauler spawns
blocks.zh: 运输舰刷新

blocks.en: NPC hauler ships can occasionally spawn in belts. They can carry up to 100M ISK worth of ores. Note that these can be easily confused with mining fleet haulers (see below), which do not carry any ore. Because of the large amount of ore dropped, be prepared to bring your own hauler in to handle the loot, as well as bookmark the loot can for easy return.
blocks.zh: 小行星带中偶尔会刷出 NPC 运输舰，它们可能携带价值高达 1 亿 ISK 的矿石。注意，这类怪很容易与采矿舰队中的运输舰（见下文）混淆，后者不携带任何矿石。由于掉落的矿石数量很大，要准备好开自己的运输舰来装战利品，并给战利品货柜做个书签，方便回来取。

blocks.en: Mining fleet
blocks.zh: 采矿舰队

blocks.en: Main article: NPC Mining Operations
blocks.zh: 主条目：NPC 采矿作业

blocks.en: Local NPC rats will occasionally send out mining fleets to support their economy. These fleets can be identified from normal rats with "♦" in front of their name. They can be attacked and killed, primarily for the loot. If attacked, a response fleet will warp in, designed to tackle you, dampen your sensors, heal the damage you deal, and kill you, while the mining fleet warps off to a deadspace safe (which can be scanned down with combat probes). Killing the initial mining fleet can reward Faction Module BPCs, Faction Drone BPCs, and certain Faction skins. The response fleet rewards no loot.
blocks.zh: 本地的 NPC 海盗偶尔会派出采矿舰队来支撑经济。这些舰队的名字前面带有“♦”，可以借此与普通怪区分。它们可以被攻击和击杀，主要是为了拾取物。一旦遭到攻击，会有一支响应舰队跃迁过来，负责拦截你、抑阻你的感应器、修复你造成的伤害并击杀你，同时采矿舰队会跃迁到一个死亡空间安全点（可以用战斗探针扫出来）。击杀最初的采矿舰队可能获得势力装备蓝图拷贝、势力无人机蓝图拷贝和某些势力涂装。响应舰队不掉落任何物品。

blocks.en: Officer spawns
blocks.zh: 官员刷新

blocks.en: Officer spawns are some of the rarest spawns in the game (colloquially cited as 'one in a million'), and some of the toughest to solo. It is highly recommended to bring a capital ship to kill them. When killed, the officer will always drop a dog tag named for the officer killed, some faction ammo, and a large number of faction officer modules (anywhere from 4 to 8). The wreck also has a chance to drop a faction implant and anywhere from zero to more than 3 officer modules.
blocks.zh: 官员怪是游戏中最稀有的刷新之一（俗称“百万分之一”），也是最难单刷的之一。强烈建议开旗舰去打。官员被击杀后必定掉落一枚以该官员命名的身份标签、一些势力弹药，以及大量官员装备（4 到 8 件不等）。残骸还有几率掉落势力植入体，以及 0 到 3 件以上的官员装备。

blocks.en: Commander spawns
blocks.zh: 指挥官刷新

blocks.en: Main article: NPC naming conventions
blocks.zh: 主条目：NPC 命名规则

blocks.en: Commander ships inflict more damage and have better range than other rats of a similar class. Commanders tend to be rare spawns, and can also carry Faction Items as loot.
blocks.zh: 指挥官舰船比同级别的其他怪伤害更高、射程更远。指挥官通常是稀有刷新，也可能掉落势力物品。

blocks.en: Commander ships are always prefixed with the following titles:
blocks.zh: 指挥官舰船名字前总是带有以下称号：

blocks.en: Capital spawns
blocks.zh: 旗舰刷新

blocks.en: Rarely, a capital ship will spawn in belts or in the final wave of some combat anomalies. Rogue Drones will spawn carriers/supercarriers, while pirates (Blood Raider, Gurista, Serpentis, Angel) will spawn dreadnoughts and titans. Sansha is a slight variation of this: while they spawn dreadnoughts, they spawn supercarriers instead of titans. They will be named one of three ways, and carry the following bounties:
blocks.zh: 极少数情况下，矿带或某些战斗异常的最后一波中会刷出旗舰。自由无人机会刷出航空母舰/超级航母，而海盗（血袭者、古斯塔斯、天蛇、天使）会刷出无畏舰和泰坦。萨沙稍有不同：他们会刷出无畏舰，但刷的是超级航母而不是泰坦。它们的命名有三种方式，对应的赏金如下：

zh: <指挥官称号><势力>无畏舰/航空母舰 - 120,000,000 ISK
<指挥官称号><势力>泰坦/超级航母 - 240,000,000 ISK

blocks.en: If you encounter a capital spawn, you should warp out immediately! These ships are very tanky, deal enough damage to quickly dispose of a regular ratting ship, and will point you from 70+ km away if you don't leave the grid quickly. Grab some friends (or a capital ship of your own) to go kill it instead.
blocks.zh: 如果遇到旗舰刷新，应立即跃迁离开！这些船非常耐打，伤害足以迅速干掉一艘普通刷怪船，如果你不赶快离开这片网格，它们会在 70+ km 外就把你扰断。不如叫上几个朋友（或开你自己的旗舰）回来打它。

blocks.en: Fits to combat capital spawns must contain multiple scrams, or they will warp away. Capital spawns also come with a number of regular cruisers as a screening fleet, and should be dealt with before the capital spawn proper.
blocks.zh: 用来打旗舰刷新的装配必须带多个扰频器，否则它会跃迁跑掉。旗舰刷新还会带着一些普通巡洋舰作为护卫舰队，应该先处理掉它们，再打旗舰本体。

blocks.en: It is recommended to salvage the capital wrecks as well since they give a large amount of T1/T2 salvage that often offsets their (relatively) low unit price.
blocks.zh: 建议同时打捞旗舰残骸，因为它们会给出大量 T1/T2 打捞材料，数量通常能弥补其（相对）较低的单价。

blocks.en: Ratting in combat sites
blocks.zh: 在战斗站点刷怪

blocks.en: Main article: Guide to combat sites
blocks.zh: 主条目：战斗站点指南

blocks.en: Main article: Combat sites
blocks.zh: 主条目：战斗站点

blocks.en: The scanner window, with a combat Anomaly and a combat signature halfway scanned down.
blocks.zh: 扫描窗口，显示一个战斗异常和一个扫描到一半的战斗信号。

blocks.en: Combat sites are randomly spawned locations inside a system where pilots can fight NPCs. These sites can be divided into anomalies, signatures, escalations and static complexes.
blocks.zh: 战斗站点是星系内随机刷新的地点，飞行员可以在其中与 NPC 战斗。这些站点可分为异常、信号、升级站点和固定复合体。

en: Visible in probe window without scanner
Low chance to either spawn Commander rats or Dreadnought capital rats (like in belts)
Can escalate into DED sites or Expeditions
Can either be gotten as an escalation from clearing an combat anomaly, or be found in system (where it needs to be scanned down with probes)
Unrated Complexes have moderate chances for faction spawn and low chance to escalate into a new combat site
DED combat sites have guaranteed faction spawns that can drop DED modules and can under some circumstances escalate into a new DED site
Escalates from anomalies and unrated signatures
And as such cannot be found, but must be gotten from other combat sites
They usually consist of many parts, and expeditions can escalation into new expeditions in new systems
zh: 不用扫描就能在探针窗口中看到
有较低几率刷出指挥官怪或无畏舰旗舰怪（和矿带一样）
可能升级为 DED 站点或远征
可以通过清理战斗异常后的升级获得，也可以在星系里找到（需要用探针扫出来）
无评级复合体有中等几率刷出势力怪，并有较低几率升级为新的战斗站点
DED 战斗站点必定刷出势力怪，可能掉落 DED 装备，并且在某些情况下可以升级为新的 DED 站点
由异常和无评级信号升级而来
因此无法直接找到，只能从其他战斗站点获得
通常由多个部分组成，远征还可能在新的星系升级出新的远征

blocks.en: The system security (not true-sec) determines the level of the sites that spawn, while the region determines what pirate faction sites spawn.
blocks.zh: 星系安全等级（不是真实安全等级）决定刷新的站点等级，而星域决定刷新哪个海盗势力的站点。

blocks.en: It is recommended to focus on the following null-sec combat anomalies for the best ISK/h due to high number of battleships or the possibility to escalate to lucrative DED-rated sites:
blocks.zh: 建议专注于以下 00 区战斗异常，因为它们战列舰多，或者可能升级为收益丰厚的 DED 评级站点，每小时 ISK 收益最高：

blocks.en: Rogue drone combat sites are generally not worth running compared to other combat sites or belt-ratting.
blocks.zh: 与其他战斗站点或刷矿带相比，自由无人机战斗站点通常不值得刷。

blocks.en: Unrated combat sites, DED combat sites, and Expeditions are generally more challenging and need preparations or to be done in a group, but also offer higher rewards. It is important to know that while higher classes of combat anomalies mean harder combat, the difficulty of Unrated Complexes, DED Complexes or Expeditions does not 100% correlate with their class.
blocks.zh: 无评级战斗站点、DED 战斗站点和远征通常更具挑战性，需要做准备或组队完成，但奖励也更高。需要知道的是，战斗异常的级别越高战斗越难，但无评级复合体、DED 复合体或远征的难度与其级别并不完全对应。

blocks.en: Tips
blocks.zh: 小贴士

blocks.en: Combat anomalies consist of one ungated pocket, with the first wave of rats already present and more spawning in waves when previous ships get destroyed. To avoid being overrun, you should look up the wave trigger, and kill the trigger ship last.
blocks.zh: 战斗异常由一个无加速门的口袋空间构成，第一波怪一开始就在，之后每当前一波舰船被消灭就会刷出新的一波。为避免被怪淹没，你应该查清楚刷波的触发怪，最后再杀它。

blocks.en: Once you enter a combat anomaly, burn away from the warp-in and make sure that you don't fly directly towards the rats, as this makes you far to easy to kill. Once you have gained some distance from the warp-in, drop down a Mobile Tractor Unit (MTU) and orbit it at about 20 km. The reason to get away from the warp-in, is so you aren't too close to it if hostile players warps to it. The MTU is not a must, but it makes looting and potential salvaging far easier. Just remember to bookmark it in case you have to warp off.
blocks.zh: 进入战斗异常后，先朝远离跃迁落点的方向开，并且不要直接朝怪飞过去，那样你很容易被打死。离跃迁落点有一段距离后，放下一个移动式牵引装置（MTU），以约 20 km 环绕它。远离跃迁落点是为了在敌对玩家跃迁过来时，你不会离他们太近。MTU 不是必需的，但能让拾取和打捞方便得多。只是要记得给它做书签，以防你需要跃迁离开。

blocks.en: Combat signatures and Expeditions are far more varied, and it is therefore harder to provide general advice. They usually consists of multiple gated deadspace pockets. This means that hostile players cannot warp directly to you, but have to scan you down with combat probes and take the gates to reach you. This makes you far harder to catch while running the site.
blocks.zh: 战斗信号和远征的情况多种多样，因此很难给出通用建议。它们通常由多个带加速门的死亡空间口袋组成。这意味着敌对玩家无法直接跃迁到你身边，而必须用战斗探针扫出你的位置并通过加速门才能到达。这让你在刷站点时更难被抓到。

blocks.en: The higher difficulty of combat sites means that you want better ships than for regular belt ratting. Consider flying more advanced ships such as the Gila or Ishtar.
blocks.zh: 战斗站点难度更高，所以你需要比普通刷矿带更好的船。可以考虑开毒蜥级或伊什塔级这类更高级的舰船。

blocks.en: Building for target NPCs
blocks.zh: 针对目标 NPC 装配

blocks.en: Main article: NPC damage types
blocks.zh: 主条目：NPC 伤害类型

blocks.en: Just like player ships, NPCs have different resistances for different damage types. However, NPCs tend to ignore the native resistance conventions of shields and armor, and instead have damage resistances which are specific to their faction. If you are running missions or ratting, it is helpful to know towards which damage the NPCs are weak and what damage they deal. This way you can can fit your ship accordingly and maximize your effectiveness against your chosen targets. You can see the resistances and damage types dealt in the attribute tab of an NPC if you open its info window.
blocks.zh: 和玩家舰船一样，NPC 对不同伤害类型有不同的抗性。不过，NPC 往往不遵循护盾和装甲固有的抗性规律，而是拥有各自势力特有的伤害抗性。如果你在做任务或刷怪，了解 NPC 怕什么伤害、打什么伤害会很有帮助。这样你就能相应地装配舰船，最大化对所选目标的效率。打开 NPC 的信息窗口，在属性页中可以看到它的抗性和造成的伤害类型。

blocks.en: In general, all NPCs from a certain faction have similar damage profiles, making them much more predictable than player ships. Additionally, each faction only uses particular types of electronic warfare; this is also noted in the table below. Ship fitting tools like PYFA can simulate combat against rats of different factions, giving you even more fine-grained control over your fit. Please note that a few special NPCs don't follow the pattern of their faction.
blocks.zh: 一般来说，同一势力的所有 NPC 伤害特征都相近，因此比玩家舰船好预测得多。此外，每个势力只使用特定类型的电子战，下表中也有注明。PYFA 等装配工具可以模拟与不同势力的怪作战，让你更精细地调整装配。请注意，少数特殊 NPC 并不遵循其势力的规律。

blocks.en: Bounties
blocks.zh: 赏金

blocks.en: Most rats have an associated bounty tied to them. This value is static, based on the type of ship (as opposed to the class). For example, an Angel Hijaker (a frigate) will always have a bounty of 4,000 ISK, while an Angel Ambusher (also a frigate) will always have a bounty of 10,000 ISK.
blocks.zh: 大多数怪都有对应的赏金。这个数值是固定的，取决于舰船型号（而不是级别）。例如，Angel Hijacker（一艘护卫舰）的赏金永远是 4,000 ISK，而 Angel Ambusher（同样是护卫舰）的赏金永远是 10,000 ISK。

blocks.en: Bounty pay-outs in a system are affected by the Dynamic Bounty System. Player deaths in a system increase that system's Bounty Risk Modifier, which acts as a multiplier on the base bounty rate for NPC kills in that system. NPC kills slowly cause that modifier to fall. Over time, the modifier will drift towards a equilibrium rate.
blocks.zh: 星系内的赏金发放受动态赏金系统影响。玩家在星系内死亡会提高该星系的赏金风险系数，这个系数是该星系 NPC 击杀基础赏金的乘数。击杀 NPC 会让这个系数慢慢下降。随着时间推移，系数会趋向一个平衡值。

blocks.en: Bounties are not paid out immediately, but are instead paid out every 20 minutes. This timer starts once you kill your first rat of a session. Any rats killed within that 20 minute window will pay out after the 20 minute window has expired. Any rats killed at T+21 to T+40 will pay out in the next window, and so on. If you do not kill any rats in 20 minutes, your timer is reset.
blocks.zh: 赏金不是立即发放的，而是每 20 分钟发放一次。这个计时器从你本次刷怪击杀第一只怪时开始。在这 20 分钟内击杀的所有怪，会在 20 分钟结束后发放赏金。在 T+21 到 T+40 之间击杀的怪会在下一个周期发放，依此类推。如果你 20 分钟内没有击杀任何怪，计时器会重置。

blocks.en: Bounties are split between anyone on grid and in fleet with you. In instances where multiple players not in the same fleet are killing rats, only the player (or fleet) that lands the killing blow is awarded the bounty.
blocks.zh: 赏金会在与你处于同一网格并且在同一舰队的所有人之间分配。如果有多名不在同一舰队的玩家在刷同一批怪，只有打出最后一击的玩家（或舰队）能获得赏金。
